Some mummies of baboons have been discovered, suggesting ritual significance. Early zoologists relied on these depictions to understand baboon anatomy and posture. The baboon’s social behavior impressed ancient observers, who may have seen parallels with human organization. These artistic records demonstrate that humans have been fascinated with primate intelligence for millennia.
